parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Opening Prayer O God, who didst raise up in the noble Priscilla a servant of surpassing generosity, who opened her home and her lands to the persecuted members of Thy holy Church, grant that through her intercession we may receive the graces we seek in this novena, and that, following her example of hidden and selfless charity, we may spend ourselves without reserve in the service of Thy Body on earth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

In Honor of Priscilla’s Welcome of the Persecuted Saint Priscilla, in an age when to shelter a Christian was to court death, you opened the estates of your family on the Via Salaria as a refuge for the faithful. You did not count the cost of your charity, nor weigh the danger against your comfort. Teach us, we pray, to receive Christ in the stranger, the suffering, and the outcast, without calculation and without fear. Closing Prayer of the Novena O glorious Saint Priscilla, matron of Rome and mother of the faithful, thou whose name is inscribed not in the chronicles of emperors but in the galleries of the holy dead, look with tenderness upon us who call upon thee. We are pilgrims as thou wert a pilgrim, and we seek the same city that thou didst seek, that city not built with hands, eternal in the heavens. Obtain for us the grace of a generous heart, a detached hand, and a hidden life well-pleasing to God. Present our needs to the Lord who repays a hundredfold all that is given for love of Him, and bring us at last to that blessed company of saints and martyrs who now fill with their glory the darkness where they once lay sleeping. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. St. Priscilla, pray for us! Amen. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Closing Prayer of the Novena O glorious Saint Priscilla, matron of Rome and mother of the faithful, thou whose name is inscribed not in the chronicles of emperors but in the galleries of the holy dead, look with tenderness upon us who call upon thee. We are pilgrims as thou wert a pilgrim, and we seek the same city that thou didst seek, that city not built with hands, eternal in the heavens. Obtain for us the grace of a generous heart, a detached hand, and a hidden life well-pleasing to God. Present our needs to the Lord who repays a hundredfold all that is given for love of Him, and bring us at last to that blessed company of saints and martyrs who now fill with their glory the darkness where they once lay sleeping. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. St. Priscilla, pray for us! Amen. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
